## Automated Tests Required

### PC-1 — Logic
- Out-of-sight and out-of-range (`ping_max_range_m` 40) pings rejected; no recipient gets them.
- Token bucket, Formulas example: 3 at t=0 accepted, t=1 rejected (0.5 tokens), t=2 accepted; 10 in 1 s gives exactly 3. Reconnect keeps tokens.
- Hidden survivor as warning target rejected; taser never a target; True Form monster warning labelled "Monster".
- Edge cases: exactly `ping_max_range_m`; a rejected ping spends no token; spoofed sender name ignored.

### PC-2 — Logic
- Each state row of the GDD States table: Healthy all; Downed pings + "Need rescue" + "Danger" only; Seized, Eliminated, Escaped none; monster true form and transforming none.
- Shock lock: rejected for `stun_duration_s`, first after it accepted; immune and post-lock hits block nothing.
- Borrowed survivor Eliminated or Escaped rejects; Downed or Seized allows every callout.

### PC-3 — Logic
- Formulas example: "Danger" t=0, "Wait" t=3 accepted, "Danger" t=6 rejected, t=8 accepted; t=1 different line rejected.
- Attached item ping spends one token; at 0 tokens the callout plays alone.
- Fake callout leaves every limit state untouched; never carries an attached ping.

### PC-4 — Integration (real ENet, 5 clients)
- Item ping reaches 3 survivors, the monster only with line of sight (facing ignored), within 250 ms (simulated 100 ms RTT).
- Downed sender, target outside monster sight: monster receives nothing.
- Rejected ping: pending marker removed, nothing sent. Hiding-spot item ping carries no occupant. Spectator mirrors its watched survivor.

### PC-5 — Logic
- Warning marker static through target movement and transform; newest `ping_max_active` (2) kept; expiry at `ping_lifetime_s`; same-name senders not merged.

### PC-6 — Integration
- Range by straight-line distance (25 m; "Need rescue" 40 m through a wall); out of range nothing.
- Monster payload has no feed line, name or direction field.
- Hidden survivor's callout originates at the spot with no gesture; rule-4 information types all deliverable with voice Off.

### PC-7 — Integration
- Disguised monster's ping and callout show the borrowed name and voice.
- "(not you)": ping only within `callout_range_m` of the copied survivor; callout always; others never.
- Byte-level parity of real and fake callout messages to one survivor peer, apart from the gesture event.
- No ping or callout changes objective, downing, stun or outcome state.

### SE-1 — Logic
- Catalogue load validation (missing field is a load problem). Every server `ScareTriggered` has a source; Monster/Survivor sources name a player; survivor projection has neither.

### SE-2 — Logic
- Major cooldown 45 s: RoundScript blocked, Monster reduced to Minor. Minor cooldown 10 s blocks RoundScript. Same id and location blocked for 120 s. Phase budget 2/6/4. Hallucinations at most 2 per round. Disguised shapeshifter gated identically. Reset per round.

### SE-3 — Integration (real ENet, 5 clients)
- Shared scare to relevant clients only, same scare_id and origin. Hallucination to its target only; nothing on the other 4.

### SE-4 — Integration
- Barricade break, reveal and Blackout fire their scares. 20 False Signals emit no `ScareTriggered`. No server state change from any scare.

### SE-5 — Integration
- Ambush test pass and fail cases (blacked-out volume; unseen for `ambush_unseen_s`; seen and lit). No flinch near a wind-up or Active lunge; freeze on cancel. Input loss at most 0.3 s.

### SE-6 — Integration
- Emergency on all 5 clients within one RTT of Evacuation. RoundScript only at authored anchors. Reconnect gets current state, no replay.

### SE-7 — Integration
- Slammed door leaves door state unchanged; lunge, sight and ping through it unchanged. RoundScript never produces footsteps, voice, ping or callout.

## Manual QA Checklist

### PC-8 — UI
**Verification method**: screenshots from `tests/manual/round_view` (ports 30000-30999)
**Who must sign off**: designer
**Evidence**: `production/qa/evidence/ping-callout-presentation/`
- [ ] Pending marker appears on press; disappears on rejection with a "too fast" tick.
- [ ] Marker through a wall shows name, colour, direction and distance; fades at expiry.
- [ ] Callout wheel shows 8 lines; feed shows `[Name]: [text]` with an arrow; 10-line scrollback; lines stay at least 8 s.
- [ ] Speaker gesture visible on a real callout; none on a hidden survivor's callout.

### SE-8 — Visual/Feel
**Verification method**: capture run plus measured bus peaks; headphone listening
**Who must sign off**: designer (audio lead)
**Evidence**: `production/qa/evidence/scare-audio/` + `scare-audio-evidence.md`
- [ ] Lunge wind-up and transform distortion at full level during a scare (measured).
- [ ] Stinger only on Major, at most +6 dB over the ambient bed (measured).
- [ ] Diegetic sound direction matches its origin (listening).
- Placeholder audio: re-verify when final audio lands.

### SE-9 — Visual/Feel
**Verification method**: screenshots
**Who must sign off**: designer
**Evidence**: `production/qa/evidence/scare-visuals-accessibility/` + `scare-visuals-accessibility-evidence.md`
- [ ] Flash scale 0: no luminance flash; timing unchanged.
- [ ] Never more than 3 flashes per second (frame-sampled capture).
- [ ] Emergency strobe and beacons visible; exit and landmarks readable.
- [ ] Impossible surveillance frame only on the target client's feed.

## Smoke Test Scope

1. Headless boot: `commands.smoke` prints `boot ok`.
2. Full suite green, no leak lines.
3. Composed round runs standalone (`round_host --self-clients`, port 30500) to RoundEnded with Pings and Scare modules registered.
4. Client round scene joins and renders (MF-11 path).
5. A ping and a callout round-trip between two clients in the client scene.
6. A scripted scare reaches a client in the client scene.
7. No save system; performance: no budget defined.
